description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Casino Business ( Regulation) Act,No.17 of 2010 (Last Amended Extra ordinary Gazette No. 2369/42 Dated February 02.2024
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of a legal regulation (Casino Business Licensing Regulation No. 1 of 2022) under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010. It establishes new regulatory requirements and fee structures for casino licensing, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. While it mentions a government official (Ranil Wickremesinghe) exercising powers vested by law, the core content is about modifying legal regulations rather than detailing government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
